description: Recommender systems can amplify misinformation harassment polarization and civic distrust.
App stores can restrict distribution payments developer access and ecosystem competition.
Sellers may depend on opaque ranking fees advertising and dispute systems.
Platform workers may lose access to income without meaningful explanation or appeal.
Cloud concentration can create systemic dependency and resilience risks.
Public digital systems can exclude people if accessibility privacy and offline alternatives are weak.
Creators depend on opaque rules algorithms and monetization policies.
AI agents can hide platform influence behind automated mediation and personalized interfaces.
